cases.condition: The request or claim map contains a private local path, email, credential-like assignment, or other forbidden sensitive text.
cases.minimum_next_action: Anonymize the first sensitive reviewer or manuscript value in a fresh request file.

cases.condition: A request, claim map, plan, or audit is linked, non-regular, oversized, changes during one-fd reading, or the output aliases an input path or inode.
cases.minimum_next_action: Use new single-link regular input files and a fresh output label that shares no input inode.

cases.condition: The request claim-map SHA-256 differs from the hash of the exact raw claim-map bytes read by the CLI.
cases.minimum_next_action: Rebind the review request to the unchanged raw claim-map bytes and rerun planning.

cases.condition: A source claim gate is a thin self-declaration or omits canonical evidence, actor, timestamp, decisiveness, finding, or limitation fields.
cases.minimum_next_action: Replace the first thin source gate with one complete canonical gate record.

cases.condition: A response or change binds a source claim above no_positive_claim, even when that upstream map self-declares support and passing gates.
cases.minimum_next_action: Validate the first positive source claim through production bundle semantics before drafting its response.

cases.condition: At least one reviewer comment has no response in the point-by-point request.
cases.minimum_next_action: Add exactly one response for the first unanswered comment ID.

cases.condition: At least one reviewer comment resolves to two or more response IDs.
cases.minimum_next_action: Deduplicate the first multiply answered comment while preserving one complete response chain.

cases.condition: A response names a change ID absent from the request and does not supply a valid exclusive no-change reason.
cases.minimum_next_action: Bind the first affected response to one existing proposed change or one explicit no-change reason.

cases.condition: A response binds multiple change IDs instead of exactly one proposed change or one no-change reason.
cases.minimum_next_action: Split or consolidate the first multi-change response into one deterministic response-to-change chain.

cases.condition: A response lacks exactly one present hashed evidence ID or its linked change uses a different evidence ID.
cases.minimum_next_action: Bind one present hashed evidence ID consistently across the first response and its change.

cases.condition: A scientific or method response binds an absent, blocked, rejected, or otherwise unsupported source claim.
cases.minimum_next_action: Resolve the first unsupported response claim in a new canonical claim map.

cases.condition: A bounded response claim references a missing or non-passing gate.
cases.minimum_next_action: Resolve the first non-passing claim gate before retaining response prose.

cases.condition: A modification claims implemented, completed, or any state beyond proposed or not-applicable without immutable changed-artifact evidence.
cases.minimum_next_action: Restore the first unverified change to proposed and defer completion to a changed-artifact workflow.

cases.condition: A proposed change has zero or multiple linked responses, mismatched comment lineage, or mismatched evidence and claim IDs.
cases.minimum_next_action: Repair the first orphaned change into one matching comment-response-change-evidence-claim chain.

cases.condition: Every comment has one response and every scientific chain has one proposed change, one present evidence item, one no-positive claim, and no raw reviewer content in outputs.
cases.minimum_next_action: Audit the unchanged redacted one-to-one response plan before local draft rendering.

cases.condition: No earlier condition can be established from the bounded review-response evidence.
cases.minimum_next_action: Stop fail closed and request one exact review request plus its bound claim map without drafting persuasive prose.
